changes.context_line: Adjusted the Thundering Bomb Specialization on Brutal Incision:
changes.change_text: Bonus Damage is no longer calculated when determining additional damage from Thundercloud stacks.
sub_lines: Increased Thundering Bomb's damage from 213% + 70 to 250% + 81.
Increased Back Attack Damage from 107% + 35 to 125% +41.
Increased the Additional Damage from each Thundercloud stack from 43% + 14 to 58% + 19.
Fixed an issue causing the incorrect amount of damage to be dealt when attacking an enemy from behind.
Added missing text in the skill tooltip describing the AoE effect when attacking an enemy with a Wet or Frost effect.

changes.skill_or_mechanic_name: Deluzhnoa's Permafrost Razors / Deluzhnoa's Piercing Daggers of Frost
changes.change_text: Deluzhnoa's Permafrost Razors / Deluzhnoa's Piercing Daggers of Frost: Adjusted the Deluzhnoa's Barrier weapon skill to apply Petrification: Icebound every 1s instead of 0.5s, with the freeze duration being increased from 1s to 1.5s.
Mana Regen above 3,500 no longer increases Defense values provided by the Mana Shield Epic Defense node.
Longbow: Fixed an issue causing the Whirlpool area granted by Nature's Blessing when the respective Specialization is active to not last the full 6s duration.
Staff: Fixed an issue causing the Aridus's Fury buff from the Aridus's Immolated Voidstaff Skill Core to be removed when using a non-Staff weapon skill.
Orb: Fixed an issue causing Tevent's Corruption to not trigger when equipped as a Skill Core in Calanthia's Vessel of Supremacy and equipped as a secondary weapon.
